payload.note: Two-scale round-tower checkpoint: on R4, Omega_epsilon=2*epsilon/(r^2+epsilon^2)+2/(r^2+1) has exact q=-2[d*(t^2+epsilon^2)+c*t]/[(1+epsilon)^2*(t+epsilon)^2], with t=r^2, d=epsilon^2-epsilon+1 and c=4*epsilon^2-epsilon^3-epsilon. At the inner scale t=epsilon^2*u, epsilon^3 E tends to 192/(1+u)^3. Exact beta integration gives ||E||^2=(9216/5)*pi^2*epsilon^-2+o(epsilon^-2), while the two residual bubbles contribute ||R||^2 -> (64/3)*pi^2. Hence Q_tower=(432/5)*epsilon^-2+o(epsilon^-2) diverges. The canonical same-center two-round-bubble tower is power-obstructed. Periodic gluing, arbitrary non-round towers, necks, irregular gases, delocalized currents, Witten coercivity, interacting H^-1, continuum, Born, Krein, and Lorentzian gates remain open.
